svg.title: AWS resources in a customer's account
svg.desc: The customer's AWS account holds two CloudFormation stacks. The Deployz connector stack connects outbound to Deployz over HTTPS and applies the application stack with CloudFormation. The application stack contains a dedicated VPC with public subnets (NAT gateway, Application Load Balancer) and private subnets (web service, workers, database, cache), plus S3 file storage, Secrets Manager secrets, and CloudWatch Logs. The connector also creates the ACM certificates, outside the application stack. Internet traffic enters through the internet gateway and the load balancer.

g.text: Created only when the application needs it
